parts.text:
I have a fully-funded 3.5 year PhD position available working in the area of electrotactile haptics. This is part of a new ERC Advanced Grant called BodyElectric. If you are interested, or know anyone who might be, then I'm happy to talk more.

Application deadline is 19th May. The funding is suitable for a UK or EU student.
I will be at CHI in Barcelona, if anyone wants to talk face-to-face about the position.
